case_analysis.thread_summary: Musen Connect IoT product registration using Nordic nRF53 + Zephyr OS. Six-message thread covering: (1) QPRDv3.0 July 2024 changes (no test/fee changes; Component→Subsystem, Declaration→Design, Consistency Check strengthened); (2) Zephyr OS version compatibility — older QDID usable if product's BT features are within that ICS scope; (3) nRF53 + Zephyr registration paths — test-exempt Design (no SIG profiles) vs. Profile Subsystem Design (SIG profiles → PTS test); (4) RF PHY QDID in Core-Complete triggers GAP test requirement — omit RF PHY QDID for relaxed check path; (5) Submission Requirements yellow ⚠ warning = advisory only, does not block Submission.
all_questions_found: What changed in QPRDv3.0 July 2024 — did test requirements or fees change?
Can we reference an older Zephyr OS QDID (v2.3.0) for a product running v2.6.0?
What is the registration path for nRF53 + Zephyr OS (with and without SIG profiles)?
Does including an RF PHY QDID in Core-Complete registration trigger a GAP test requirement?
What does the yellow ⚠ warning in Submission Requirements Design Details mean?
case_analysis.key_technical_discussion: QPRDv3.0 brought structural changes (Component→Subsystem, Declaration→Design, Compliance Folder mandatory) and strengthened the Consistency Check with inter-layer rules. QDID version compatibility depends on whether the product's actual BT features fall within the older QDID's ICS scope. nRF53+Zephyr registration is test-exempt without SIG profiles, requires PTS test with SIG profiles. RF PHY QDID inclusion triggers GAP ICS modification rule → full GAP test → typically not feasible; omit RF PHY QDID for relaxed check path. Yellow ⚠ in Submission Requirements is informational, not blocking.
case_analysis.key_decision_logic: 1. QPRDv3.0: no test/fee change, three structural changes, Consistency Check now enforced. 2. QDID version: check ICS scope against product BT features. 3. nRF53+Zephyr: profile presence determines test requirement. 4. RF PHY QDID: include only if GAP PTS test is feasible; otherwise omit. 5. Yellow warning: advisory, proceed to Submission.
case_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: Misunderstanding QPRDv3.0 as requiring new tests causes unnecessary delays. Including RF PHY QDID without ability to run GAP test blocks registration. Treating yellow Submission warning as blocking causes unnecessary project delays.
case_analysis.consulting_mistake: Not checking QDID ICS scope against product's actual BT features when older QDID is referenced. Including RF PHY QDID in Core-Complete without verifying whether GAP test is feasible.
case_analysis.consulting_takeaway: For nRF53+Zephyr projects: always confirm SIG profile implementation at intake (determines test requirement). For RF PHY QDID in Core-Complete: assess GAP test feasibility first and default to omitting RF PHY QDID if GAP test cannot be run.
